posts.text:
My 'For You' feed is currently full of Americans talking about how poor the UK has become and how much British people despise success and wealth. 

Two weeks ago, it was full of British people hating on Dubai and its residents.

Is this some form of digital karma? 😂

When I was growing up, I thought Christianity was the 'easy' religion because it doesn't mandate fasting, have explicit dietary requirements, require a certain amount of prayers per day, etc.

Over time, I've learned that consistently walking with Christ is difficult. The bar is much higher than modern norms and cultural standards.

You should raise the standards for yourself before you start raising them for other people.

Too many delusional folks out there these days.
If you're a decent person then I'm rooting for you. It's that simple. 👊🏾

When I meet new people and they ask me, "So, what do you do?" I like to respond with a random list of daily activities that have nothing to do with my career or how I earn money.

Try it. It's fun.
The sky looks crazy tonight. 💜
If you yelled at the people who opposed Covid lockdowns then please stop complaining about high inflation and cost of living. You supported it.
The financial system is a scam but the average person is also terrible with money.

The 'solution' to everything in the UK is to tax people faster and harder... As if they're not already suffering.


The Telegraph (@Telegraph)

🔴 Rachel Reeves is raising taxes at the fastest pace in the world

Read more about Britain’s tax burden ⬇️

telegraph.co.uk/business/202…





— https://nitter.net/Telegraph/status/2044438205093593402#m
People are taking dating and marriage advice from terminally single people on Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit, and then wondering why they are struggling.

Can confirm.


Eric Matheny 🎙️ (@ericmmatheny)

The greatest economic stimulus would be the complete elimination of income tax.



— https://nitter.net/ericmmatheny/status/2044464538888687976#m

I do.


Asmaa | اسماء (@FajrCoded)

People don’t consider nurturing, raising children, keeping the family and home together, being an active part of community to help the sick and the old, and educating, raising awareness that bonds people together, healing with love and care and managing affairs work.



— https://nitter.net/FajrCoded/status/2044663670295183752#m

Watching everyone online complain about taxes today.

You could just... Never mind.

Women always work and always have. What they work on changes.

Equating 'work' to paid employment is a modern psyop.


Brennan Schlagbaum, CPA (@Budgetdog_)

As a man, it is your duty to ensure your wife doesn’t have to work.



— https://nitter.net/Budgetdog_/status/2044494186473312714#m
The matrix doesn't want you to know that your government would actually function better without your trillions of tax dollars.

People will see this and blame it on 'the manosphere'. 😏


The New Statesman (@NewStatesman)

"Young women, aged between 18 and 30, are by far the most progressive demographic in the UK. They are also much more pessimistic about the future. They also feel much more negatively towards young men than young men feel about them."





— https://nitter.net/NewStatesman/status/2044378074506993936#m

The smartest way to take out a civilisation without using force is to psyop its men and women into hating each other.

Then convince them that having children is bad.

Fortunately, this is just a conspiracy theory.
Tiger VS Sloth Bear ! Tiger bhi darr gaya? 😳 Sloth Bear ka asli roop !
Tiger VS Asian Elephant ! Tiger vs Elephant 😳 Kaun asli king
जब फँसी Maruti Ertiga और आया  Force Gurkha का असली दम! Off-Road Disaster | Gurkha Ne  Bachai Ertiga?
🐆 Asiatic Cheetah – दुनिया का सबसे rare चीता! 😢Asiatic Cheetah अब लगभग खत्म होने की कगार पर…
Dhole – India का सबसे underrated hunter! 😱Dhole यानी Indian Wild Dog…
🐅 कंकटी Tigress – रणथंभौर से मुकुंदरा तक की रहस्यमयी कहानी! 😱
🌲🚶‍♂️ Jungle Trekking करते समय Headphones मत लगाओ! 😱
🦅 दुधवा में 25 गिद्धों की मौत! 😢 क्या हो रहा है जंगल में?
🦁🐅 Lion vs Tiger – असली KING कौन? 👑🔥
🐅 क्या बाघ बदला लेता है? 😱
